correctness.rationale: For the five-element inverse-closed S3 set Δ={e,s,t,st,ts}, the lone forbidden group quotient is the third transposition u=sts; specified-pair graph is K6 minus three independent forbidden edges. All maximal cliques have size 3 (six abc triangles and two ccc triangles), so local PSD is exactly determinant 1+2abc-a²-b²-c²>=0, |a|,|b|<=1, and -1/2<=c<=1. Complex PD completion implies a real one by conjugate averaging. Finite-group Peter-Weyl decomposition into trivial, sign and 2D real standard irreps yields scalar |a+b+d|<=1+2c and standard (a+b-2d)^2+3(a-b)^2<=4(1-c)^2 with c<=1. Eliminating real d gives the exact elliptical capsule. On a=b=11/16,c=0 the local determinant 7/128>0 while scalar upper d=-3/8 is below standard lower d=-5/16 by 1/16, proving strict nonglobality. Independently verified finite group products/blocks, witness and symbolic elimination; read full RESULT.md and check.py. All finite 6-element and real-parameter cases are covered analytically, sampled checker states are supplemental.
